title: On Sighing over the letter twice
subtitle: 情感心理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）
meta: 主题语境：情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）　|　核心词汇：sigh　|　正文 335 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 sigh 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1983 the headmaster ① sighed over the letter twice at once, and every student in the school said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the headmaster ② sighs over the letter twice in the rain without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ sigh over the letter twice at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ sighed over the letter twice before — a line in the record for October 1977 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Sighing over the letter twice at once, the headmaster said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the bell at the far gate, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ sigh the old complaint once more in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Sigh the old complaint once more at once and never mention it again.

By 1990 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the record, and a new student from the next school ⑧ sighs the old complaint once more at once every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the gate, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ sighed over the letter twice again when nobody else would.

⑩ To sigh over the letter twice, my mother said in 1995, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the school remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the school forgets, somebody sighs over the letter twice in the rain again and somebody must sigh over the letter twice at once all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 叹息（一般过去式 sighed over the letter twice：1983 年校长头一回这样做，二话不说地）
B. v. 叹息（一般现在 sighs over the letter twice：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 叹息（不定式 to sigh over the letter twice：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 叹息（过去完成时 had sighed over the letter twice：1977 年十月的学籍册上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 叹息（动名词 sighing over the letter twice 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 叹着说（sigh the old complaint once more：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去叹着说又把那句老话叹着说了一遍）
G. v. 叹着说（sigh the old complaint once more：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 叹息（后段两处：新来的学生照例 sighs the old complaint once more，而母亲又一次 sighed over the letter twice）

answers.why: sigh 意为“叹息”，1983 年校长二话不说地叹息为那封信叹了两回气，那是学堂里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 sighed。
sigh 意为“叹息”，自那以后校长淋着雨把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 sighs。
sigh 意为“叹息”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯叹息为那封信叹了两回气”，此处为不定式 to sigh over the letter twice。
sigh 意为“叹息”，学籍册里 十月 那行字说明早在 1990 年之前就有人叹息过，故用过去完成时 had sighed。
sigh 意为“叹息”，校长说“叹息为那封信叹了两回气这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 sighing over the letter twice 作主语。
sigh 意为“叹着说”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去叹着说又把那句老话叹着说了一遍”，should ever 之后用原形 sigh the old complaint once more。
sigh 意为“叹着说”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻叹着说又把那句老话叹着说了一遍（sigh the old complaint once more at once），以后再也不要提起。
sigh 意为“叹息”，新来的学生每个学年都照例叹着说又把那句老话叹着说了一遍，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 sighs。
sigh 意为“叹息”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次二话不说地叹息为那封信叹了两回气，用一般过去式 sighed 叙述。
sigh 意为“叹息”，结尾那句是母亲 1995 年的话：要叹息为那封信叹了两回气，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和学堂记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 sigh 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1983 the headmaster sighed over the letter twice at once, and nobody in the school forgot it.
Even now the headmaster sighs over the letter twice in the rain whenever the school asks.
Sighing over the letter twice at once, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever sigh the old complaint once more in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new student from the next school sighs the old complaint once more at once every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother sighed over the letter twice again, and the school remembered that half.
